details: This package is a derivative of the Baileys WhatsApp library that gates its socket API behind a paid licence and, on load, silently subscribes the operator's WhatsApp account to a hardcoded channel. Licence gate: makeWASocket() in lib/Socket/index.js calls verifyLicenseGuard() from lib/Utils/license-guard.js before creating the socket. That module is obfuscated with a rotated string array and RC4 decoder (a readable copy is also shipped as lib/Utils/license-guard.src.js). It reads the licence from config.licenseKey, the KRISPEDIA_LICENSE environment variable, or global.licenseKey; when no key is present it prints a banner and calls process.exit(1), terminating the host process. Valid-looking keys are sent as a GET request to hxxps://krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app/api/verify?key=<key> (the endpoint can be redirected with the LICENSE_SERVER_URL environment variable), and two hardcoded master keys are accepted offline. Hidden channel subscription: lib/Socket/newsletter.js starts a setTimeout of 120 seconds when the module is loaded and then sends a w:mex FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter over the installer's authenticated socket, discarding any error. lib/Socket/clutch-handler.js similarly defaults forwarded-newsletter metadata to the channel 120363423239131660@newsletter. No configuration flag enables this behaviour. The preinstall hook engine-requirements.js only enforces Node.js >= 20. No credentials, tokens, wallet data or local files are collected or transmitted by this package.
